inv.location: Avenida de Menéndez Pelayo, Recoletos, Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid
inv.desc_es:
Les proponemos 2 locales comerciales estupendamente bien ubicados, a proximidad del Parque del Retiro.

Local 1: Disponible

El local esta en bruto y necesita reforma total: NO TIENEN SALIDA DE HUMOS.

Antiguo bar de copas: ESTADO: EN BRUTO. Dispone de aseos en las 2 plantas.

Fachada: 6 metros aprox.
Planta Calle: 82,50 m2
Sótano: 94,10 m2
Total: 176, 60 m2

Renta: 5.500 €/mes + IVA (21%) - (31.14 €/m2/mes)
IBI: A cargo de la propiedad.
TRUA: a cargo del arrendatario.
Calefacción y agua: A cargo del arrendatario.

Local 2: Disponible:

Antigua peluquería: Estado: A REFORMAR. Dispone de aseos en las 2 plantas.

Planta Calle: 29,33 m2
Sótano: 28,98 m2
Total: 58,31 m2

Renta: 3.000 €/mes + IVA (21%) - (51,45 €/m2/mes).
IBI: A cargo de la propiedad.
TRUA: a cargo del arrendatario.
Calefacción y agua: A cargo del arrendatario.

Estudio de solvencia exigido:
- Certificado de la agencia tributaria de solvencia económica
- Certificado de solvencia bancario.

En ambos casos se pide:
2 meses de fianza.
2 meses de deposito adicional a título de garantía de pago.
Honorarios de agencia: A cargo del arrendataria e equivalentes a un mes de renta + IVA (21%).
inv.desc_en:
We offer you 2 commercial premises in a prime location, near Retiro Park.

Premises 1: Available

The premises are in raw condition and require total renovation: THEY DO NOT HAVE A SMOKE VENT.

Former cocktail bar: CONDITION: RAW. Includes restrooms on both floors.

Facade: approx. 6 meters.
Ground Floor: 82.50 m2
Basement: 94.10 m2
Total: 176.60 m2

Rent: €5,500/month + VAT (21%) - (€31.14/m2/month)
Property Tax (IBI): Paid by the owner.
Waste Tax (TRUA): Paid by the tenant.
Heating and water: Paid by the tenant.

Premises 2: Available:

Former hair salon: Condition: TO BE RENOVATED. Includes restrooms on both floors.

Ground Floor: 29.33 m2
Basement: 28.98 m2
Total: 58.31 m2

Rent: €3,000/month + VAT (21%) - (€51.45/m2/month).
Property Tax (IBI): Paid by the owner.
Waste Tax (TRUA): Paid by the tenant.
Heating and water: Paid by the tenant.

Solvency study required:
- Tax agency certificate of economic solvency
- Bank solvency certificate.

In both cases, the following is required:
2 months security deposit.
2 months additional deposit as a payment guarantee.
Agency fees: Paid by the tenant and equivalent to one month's rent + VAT (21%).
inv.title_en: Commercial premises for rent in Avenida de Menéndez Pelayo
